description: Source code for JSON reading and parsing functionality in the Chromium project, including error handling and utility functions.

classes.name: JSONReader
classes.description: A class providing static methods for reading and parsing JSON data, along with instance methods for error handling.

methods.name: JSONReader::Read
methods.description: Parses JSON string into a Value object, with options and max depth.

methods.name: JSONReader::ReadAndReturnError
methods.description: Parses JSON string and provides detailed error information if parsing fails.

methods.name: JSONReader::ErrorCodeToString
methods.description: Converts a JSON parse error code to a human-readable string.

methods.name: JSONReader::ReadToValue
methods.description: Parses JSON string into a Value object using the internal parser.

methods.name: JSONReader::error_code
methods.description: Returns the current error code from the parser.

methods.name: JSONReader::GetErrorMessage
methods.description: Returns the current error message from the parser.
